{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity, WITHOUT excluding biomarker_baseline == -999
control_moderate = data_dedup[
    (data_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & 
    (data_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')
]

# Compute the fraction who responded
n_total = len(control_moderate)
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

print(f"Number of control, moderate patients (including all biomarker_baseline values): {n_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
